EdCommon.AlignSelected.source: Align and distribute the selected objects (select two or more).

EdCommon.AssetSlotDrop.source: Drag an asset from the Content Browser and drop it here to assign it.

EdCommon.BoneNoSelection.source: No selection. Select an object in the Hierarchy.

EdCommon.BoneObjectNotFound.source: Object not found in the active scene.

EdCommon.BuildCompiling.source: Modules are being built in the background.

EdCommon.BuildFailed.source: The build failed. See the console window for the detailed errors.

EdCommon.BuildReady.source: Live Coding is ready to build.

EdCommon.CameraBookmarks.source: Camera bookmarks: move the view to a saved camera position (Ctrl+1~9)

EdCommon.CameraSpeed.source: Camera fly speed (0.5 to 20). Turning the mouse wheel while holding the right mouse button also changes it.

EdCommon.CommandPaletteHint.source: Type a command or search objects... (Esc to close)

EdCommon.CompileGame.source: Live Coding: compile the SWGame module now and hot-reload it (Ctrl+Alt+F11)

EdCommon.ComponentCardOptions.source: More options for this component, including removing it.

EdCommon.CurveEditorHint.source: Click a key to edit it. Right-click to add a key. F fits the view.

EdCommon.DebugHUDNotRunningHost.source: Debug HUD is not running (Shipping or a test host).

EdCommon.DebugHUDSavedIn.source: Saved in the engine user settings (debug.hud, debug.hudSections, debug.hudCorner, debug.hudOpacity)

EdCommon.DebugHUDShow.source: Show the in-game Debug HUD in the game view, with the sections chosen below (Ctrl+F3)

EdCommon.DocumentOpen.source: Find and open an asset of this type (the same as Quick Open or double-clicking it in the Content Browser).

EdCommon.GizmoLocalSpace.source: Local space: the gizmo follows the object's rotation. Click to switch to world space.

EdCommon.GizmoRotate.source: Rotate: turn the selection around an axis (E)

EdCommon.GizmoScale.source: Scale: resize the selection along an axis, or uniformly from the center (R)

EdCommon.GizmoTranslate.source: Translate: move the selection along an axis or plane (W)

EdCommon.GizmoWorldSpace.source: World space: the gizmo follows the world axes. Click to switch to local space.

EdCommon.GridSnap.source: Grid snap: moved objects jump in steps of the grid size on the right.

EdCommon.GridSnapSize.source: Grid snap step, in world units.

EdCommon.LiveCodingFailed.source: {target} build failed (exit code {code}). See the Output Log.

EdCommon.NetMode.source: Net Mode: Standalone plays inside the editor; the other modes launch a separate server and clients (Window > Multiplayer).

EdCommon.NetPlayClients.source: Connected clients / launched clients. The process list and server pause are in Window > Multiplayer.

EdCommon.NetPlayStart.source: Launch a separate server and clients and connect them. Logs gather in the Output Log as [Server] and [Client1], and Stop shuts them all down.

EdCommon.NetPlayStop.source: Shut down every process cleanly and, if tracing is on, merge the traces into one file.

EdCommon.NetPlayerCount.source: Number of players: the client count for a dedicated server, or the count including the host for a listen host.

EdCommon.NoAssetsOfKind.source: No assets of this kind under Resource/.

EdCommon.NotifyBugReportFailed.source: The bug report could not be saved (see the log)

EdCommon.NotifyKeepSimulation.source: The selected objects keep their state after Stop

EdCommon.NotifyPlayNewWindowSaveFirst.source: Save the scene first. The new window opens the saved file.

EdCommon.NotifyPlayNewWindowUnsaved.source: Unsaved scene edits are not in the new window

EdCommon.NotifyPlayUnsaved.source: The scene has unsaved changes. Use Play on the toolbar to confirm.

EdCommon.NotifyPrefabIsolated.source: Opened the prefab in the Prefab Window

EdCommon.NotifyPresetApplyFailed.source: Failed to apply the preset to this component

EdCommon.NotifyPresetWriteFailed.source: Failed to write the preset file

EdCommon.NotifySceneReadOnly.source: The scene file is read-only. Check it out (lock it) in the Content Browser first.

EdCommon.NotifyScreenshotFailed.source: The screenshot was not written (see the log)

EdCommon.NotifyScreenshotNoSceneView.source: The scene view is not drawn. Open the Scene tab first.

EdCommon.NotifyStopPlayFirst.source: Stop play before opening or creating a scene

EdCommon.OverlayGrip.source: Drag to move. Near an edge it docks there (left and right stack vertically). Right-click for the overlay menu.

EdCommon.OverlaysMenu.source: Show or hide the scene view overlay bars, or put them back where they started

EdCommon.PlayRunning.source: The game is running. The game view draws the game camera, and the scene view lets you look around with the editor camera.

EdCommon.PlayStart.source: Start play mode (enables game view input and player control).

EdCommon.PlayStartAtCamera.source: Start Play at the editor camera position (moves the object tagged 'Player', or else the object holding the game camera).

EdCommon.PlayStarting.source: Opening the scene. Play starts when loading finishes (Stop cancels it).

EdCommon.PlayStepFrameCount.source: Number of frames 'Step N' advances (1 or more).

EdCommon.PlayStepFrames.source: Advance by the number of frames in the box on the left, then pause.

EdCommon.PlayStepOnce.source: Advance the game by exactly one frame.

EdCommon.PlayStop.source: Stop the game and restore the scene to its state before Play.

EdCommon.PlayTimeScale.source: Game time scale (gv_timeScale). Drag to change it; right-click to reset it to x1.00.

EdCommon.QuickOpenHint.source: Type to search assets, scenes, game objects (ESC to cancel)...

EdCommon.QuickOpenNoMatches.source: No matching assets or game objects found.

EdCommon.RHISwitch.source: Switch the RHI with a command-line argument: -dx11 / -dx12 / -vk / -gl

EdCommon.RecentDocuments.source: Recently opened documents. Pick one to open it again.

EdCommon.RenderDocCapture.source: Capture the next frame with RenderDoc (Saved/RenderDoc/, Ctrl+F12)

EdCommon.RenderDocUnavailable.source: RenderDoc is not attached to this process. Start with -renderdoc or launch from RenderDoc.

EdCommon.ResetLayout.source: Reset the docked windows to the default editor layout.

EdCommon.RotationSnap.source: Rotation snap: rotations jump in steps of the angle on the right.

EdCommon.SaveLayout.source: Save the current dock layout and panel visibility under this name (Saved/Editor/Layouts; letters, digits, spaces, _ and - only).

EdCommon.SimulateRunning.source: Only the world is ticking: no game module update and no game input.

EdCommon.SimulateStart.source: Start simulate mode (ticks the scene only: no game module update and no game input).

EdCommon.SurfaceSnap.source: Surface snap: objects you drag land on the surface under the cursor.

EdCommon.ThemeAccentColor.source: The accent color used for buttons, selection highlights, folders and active items.

EdCommon.ThemeAccentSwatch.source: A recommended accent color. Click to apply it.

EdCommon.ThemeFrameRounding.source: Corner rounding of buttons, input fields and control frames, in pixels (0 to 8).

EdCommon.ThemePreset.source: Choose the editor theme (Dark, Light, High Contrast and more). Themes are token files under Resource/editor/theme.

EdCommon.ThemeReset.source: Drop your accent and rounding changes and use the values of the current theme.

EdCommon.ThemeTabRounding.source: Corner rounding of dock tabs and panel tabs, in pixels (0 to 8).

EdCommon.ThemeWindowRounding.source: Corner rounding of editor windows and popup dialogs, in pixels (0 to 12).

EdCommon.Vec3AxisDrag.source: Drag to change the value, or double-click to type a number.

EdCommon.Vec3AxisReset.source: Click to reset this axis to its default value.

EdCommon.View2D.source: 2D view (XY plane grid). Click to switch to 3D.

EdCommon.View3D.source: 3D view (XZ plane grid). Click to switch to 2D.

EdCommon.ViewMode.source: Scene view mode: Lit / Unlit / Wireframe / Normals / Depth / Overdraw (the game view always draws Lit)

EdCommon.ViewModeNoRenderer.source: The renderer is not attached yet.

EdCommon.ViewportGrid.source: Show or hide the ground grid.

EdCommon.ViewportHUD.source: Show the Debug HUD box in this view (view size and HUD sections). Right-click to choose sections.

EdCommon.ViewportOrientationCube.source: Show or hide the orientation cube that shows which way the camera faces.

EditorAnimationGraph.AddAttackTip.source: Add an Attack state node. Its name is the clip it plays; rename it in the inspector.

EditorAnimationGraph.AddBoneMaskTip.source: Add a bone mask that starts at the spine. Rename its bones to match your skeleton.

EditorAnimationGraph.AddIdleTip.source: Add an Idle state node. Its name is the clip it plays; rename it in the inspector.

EditorAnimationGraph.AddLayerTip.source: Add a layer. Layers stack in list order; the last one is on top.

EditorAnimationGraph.AddWalkTip.source: Add a Walk state node. Its name is the clip it plays; rename it in the inspector.

EditorAnimationGraph.AdvanceTip.source: Step the preview to the next state by one transition.

EditorAnimationGraph.BoneMaskChildrenTip.source: Checked: the weight spreads to every child bone. Unchecked: only this bone.

EditorAnimationGraph.BoneMaskPresetTip.source: Drop a .bonemask.json preset to use it; its bones are then read-only here. Clear it to keep the bones in this graph.

EditorAnimationGraph.ConditionOpTip.source: How the parameter is compared with Value. (on finish) moves on when the clip ends; Trigger fires once when the parameter is set.

EditorAnimationGraph.ConditionParamTip.source: Graph parameter the condition reads (set by game code through the player)

EditorAnimationGraph.ConditionValueTip.source: The threshold the parameter is compared against.

EditorAnimationGraph.ContextCreateFailed.source: Failed to create Animation Graph editor context.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerBlendTip.source: Override replaces the masked bones; Additive adds the clip's difference from its first frame.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerClipTip.source: Clip this layer plays (its name in the clip folder).

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerHalfLifeTip.source: When the layer restarts, blend out of the interrupted pose with this half-life. 0 switches at once.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerMaskTip.source: Bones the layer affects. (all bones) applies it to the whole skeleton.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerOrderTip.source: Move the selected layer up or down. Order changes the result: later layers are applied on top.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerWeightParamTip.source: Animator parameter that drives the weight every frame (clamped to 0..1). Leave empty to use Weight.

EditorAnimationGraph.LayerWeightTip.source: How much of the layer pose is applied. Ignored while Weight Param is set.

EditorAnimationGraph.LinkSelectedTip.source: Add a transition between the two selected nodes, from the first selected to the second. Click one node, then Ctrl+click the other.

EditorAnimationGraph.LoadTip.source: Reload the graph from disk, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorAnimationGraph.NoBoneMasksHint.source: No bone masks. A mask chooses the bones a layer affects and how strongly.

EditorAnimationGraph.NoLayersHint.source: No layers. A layer plays one clip over the state machine pose, on the bones of its mask.

EditorAnimationGraph.PlayTip.source: Preview the graph from the entry state, stepping to the next state every 0.75 seconds. Use it to check the transition order.

EditorAnimationGraph.SaveTip.source: Write the graph and its node layout to the asset file.

EditorAnimationGraph.StateClipTip.source: The state's clip name - the player plays the clip with this name

EditorAnimationGraph.StateLoopTip.source: Whether this state's clip repeats. Default keeps the clip's own loop setting.

EditorAnimationGraph.TransitionBlendTip.source: Crossfade seconds; below zero uses the player default

EditorAnimationRewind.AllTracksTip.source: Draw every recorded character's skeleton, not only the selected one.

EditorAnimationRewind.NothingRecorded.source: Nothing recorded yet. Turn recording on and play (PIE) - or 'anim.rewind on' in the console.

EditorAnimationRewind.RecordTip.source: Record every animated character's pose and state each frame while the game plays, so you can scrub back and inspect them. Same as 'anim.rewind on'.

EditorAnimationRewind.ResumeTip.source: Return to the live state and resume Play In Editor if scrubbing paused it.

EditorAnimationRewind.SelectCharacter.source: Select a character (Hierarchy or Scene view) to see its recorded state.

EditorAnimationRewind.SkeletonTip.source: Draw the recorded skeleton in the viewport at the time being viewed.

EditorAnimationRewind.TimelineTip.source: Drag to scrub through the recorded history; the left end is the oldest frame. Scrubbing pauses Play In Editor.

EditorAnimationRewind.WindowTip.source: How many seconds of history to keep, 1 to 60. Older frames are dropped; longer windows use more memory.

EditorAudioEvents.DeleteEventTip.source: Removes the event from the edited copy; saving writes the library file

EditorAudioEvents.EditEventTip.source: Edits a copy of this event's library file; Save writes it only when it passes validation, and hot reload applies it

EditorAudioEvents.NoService.source: The audio service is not running

EditorAudioEvents.OpenDataFileTip.source: Event data is edited in its .audioevents.xml file; saving reloads it. Copies the path when no tool opens it

EditorAudioEvents.PlayedDroppedTip.source: Events posted since start, and events dropped by cooldown, limit or slot shortage

EditorAudioEvents.SaveEditsTip.source: Writes the library file; an invalid library is not written and the error is logged

EditorAudioEvents.SelectEvent.source: Select an event on the left

EditorBugIt.Capture.source: Collect a screenshot, log, scene copy, camera position and repro command into Saved/BugIt/<time>/ with the note above

EditorBugIt.GoTo.source: Open that scene and move the camera to the saved position (bugitgo)

EditorBugIt.NoReports.source: No bug reports yet. Collect Now saves one under Saved/BugIt.

EditorBugIt.NoteHint.source: Note to attach (what you did and what went wrong)

EditorBugIt.ShowInExplorer.source: Open this folder in the file explorer

EditorConsole.AllLevelsHidden.source: All log levels are hidden. Re-enable one in the toolbar.

EditorConsole.AutoScroll.source: Follow new logs while scrolled to the bottom. Scrolling up to read pauses it; scrolling back to the bottom resumes it

EditorConsole.ClearOnPlay.source: Clear the log when Play starts

EditorConsole.Collapse.source: Fold identical log lines into one and show the count in front

EditorConsole.CommandHint.source: > command or gv_name [value] (Tab completes, Up/Down history, help)

EditorConsole.CopyAll.source: Copy every filtered console log to the clipboard

EditorConsole.ErrorPause.source: Pause Play when an error log appears during Play

EditorConsole.FilterTooltip.source: Filter by log message, module tag or file name

EditorConsole.OpenLogFile.source: Open the most recent saved log file in the file explorer

EditorConsole.TagFilter.source: Show or hide each log tag (category)

EditorContentBrowser.AddAsset.source: Create a new folder or asset (material, scene, prefab) in the current folder

EditorContentBrowser.AllPacks.source: Off shows only the active game pack; on shows every pack under game/ (default: Preferences > Content Browser)

EditorContentBrowser.Import.source: Import external files (textures, shaders, sounds, ...) into the current folder

EditorContentBrowser.ImportNeedsFolder.source: Select a target folder to import assets into first

EditorContentBrowser.IndexingReferences.source: Indexing references. Try again in a moment.

EditorContentBrowser.ListView.source: Show assets as a detailed list of name, type and path

EditorContentBrowser.NavigateBack.source: Go to the previous folder (Mouse Back button / Alt+Left / Backspace)

EditorContentBrowser.NavigateForward.source: Go to the next folder (Mouse Forward button / Alt+Right)

EditorContentBrowser.NoDependencies.source: This asset names no other asset.

EditorContentBrowser.NoReferencers.source: No text asset names this asset.

EditorContentBrowser.Refresh.source: Refresh the disk files and the resource root list

EditorContentBrowser.SearchTooltip.source: Filter assets by name or extension

EditorContentBrowser.TileSize.source: Adjust the tile thumbnail size (64px to 160px)

EditorContentBrowser.TilesView.source: Show assets as square thumbnail cards (tiles)

EditorContentBrowser.TypeFilter.source: Filter by asset type (texture, scene, prefab, sound, ...)

EditorDataTable.AddKeyTip.source: Add a string with the key typed on the left. Keys already in the table are ignored.

EditorDataTable.DeleteKeyTip.source: Remove this key from the source table and every translation table when you save.

EditorDataTable.NoRecordsHint.source: No localization records. Add a key or run App --gather-text.

EditorDataTable.ProjectTip.source: Localization project whose string tables are shown. Save or reload before switching; a project with unsaved edits stays selected.

EditorDataTable.RefreshFilesTip.source: Scan the game data folders again for XML tables added or removed outside the editor.

EditorDataTable.ReloadTip.source: Read the project's tables from disk again, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorDataTable.RevertTip.source: Discard the edits and read the file from disk again.

EditorDataTable.SaveFileTip.source: Write the edited XML text back to this file. The text is saved as typed, without validation.

EditorDataTable.SaveLocalizationTip.source: Write the source table and every translation table of this project.

EditorDataTable.SelectTableHint.source: Select an XML data table from the list on the left.

EditorDataTable.StateReview.source: needs review (translation memory suggestion or fuzzy import)

EditorDataTable.StateStale.source: stale - the source changed after this translation

EditorDialogueGraph.AddChoiceTip.source: Add an option the player can pick. Each option gets its own output pin.

EditorDialogueGraph.AddNodeTip.source: Add a node of this type to the graph. You can also right-click empty canvas to search for one.

EditorDialogueGraph.AdvancePreviewTip.source: Move the preview to the next node without waiting.

EditorDialogueGraph.CommandTip.source: Command the game runs when the conversation passes this node, written as name:argument:argument.

EditorDialogueGraph.ConditionTip.source: Expression the game evaluates when the conversation reaches this node; true follows the True link, false the False link.

EditorDialogueGraph.ContextCreateFailed.source: Failed to create Dialogue Node Editor context.

EditorDialogueGraph.PlayPreviewTip.source: Run the conversation from the Start node and show each line in the viewport. Lines advance on their own; choices and conditions wait for the buttons that appear.

EditorDialogueGraph.PreviewChoiceTip.source: Pick this choice and follow its link.

EditorDialogueGraph.PreviewFalseTip.source: Treat the condition as not met and follow the False link.

EditorDialogueGraph.PreviewTrueTip.source: Treat the condition as met and follow the True link.

EditorDialogueGraph.ReloadTip.source: Reload the graph from disk, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorDialogueGraph.ResetDefaultTip.source: Replace the whole graph with the sample conversation.

EditorDialogueGraph.SaveTip.source: Write the dialogue graph and its node layout to the asset file.

EditorDialogueGraph.SpeakerTip.source: Name shown as the speaker of this line.

EditorDialogueGraph.TextTip.source: The line the player reads. On a Choice node it is the prompt shown above the options.

EditorDialogueGraph.ZoomFitTip.source: Zoom and pan the canvas so every node is visible.

EditorInputMap.ActionConflictTip.source: Shares a key with another action on the same layer - see the details

EditorInputMap.CaptureInstruction.source: Press any keyboard key, or click a button below to bind...

EditorInputMap.CreateActionTip.source: Add the action with no bindings; select it in the list to add keys.

EditorInputMap.InjectKeyDownTip.source: Send a key-press event for the chosen key, as if it were pressed and held. Send KeyUp to release it.

EditorInputMap.InjectKeyUpTip.source: Send a key-release event for the chosen key.

EditorInputMap.InjectStickTip.source: Hold gamepad 0's left stick at the tilt set above until you reset it.

EditorInputMap.InjectorHint.source: Inject virtual key, mouse, or stick events directly into the engine without physical hardware.

EditorInputMap.LayerEnabledTip.source: Whether this layer starts enabled. The enabled layer with the highest priority receives input first.

EditorInputMap.LeftMotorTip.source: Strength of the left (low-frequency) motor for the test pulse, 0 to 1.

EditorInputMap.LoadReplayTip.source: Read frames from the replay file, replacing the current recording. Stops any playback first.

EditorInputMap.MapPathTip.source: Resource path of the input map (*.input.xml) to edit. Press Reload after changing it.

EditorInputMap.NewActionNameTip.source: Name game code uses to query the new action, for example Jump or Move.

EditorInputMap.NewActionTypeTip.source: Value the action reports: Boolean for buttons, Axis 1D for a trigger or one axis, Vector 2D for a stick or WASD.

EditorInputMap.NotRebindableTip.source: This binding kind (axis, stick, mouse delta ...) is not one key - edit the XML

EditorInputMap.OverlayAnchorTip.source: Viewport corner the overlay is drawn in.

EditorInputMap.OverlayEnableTip.source: Draw a live controller display over the game viewport. Useful for recording videos or checking input while playing.

EditorInputMap.OverlayHistoryTip.source: List the most recent inputs and triggered actions, as in fighting-game training modes.

EditorInputMap.PatternExample.source: 236P = down, down-right, right + punch (the map's command history, 0.8 s window)

EditorInputMap.PatternTip.source: Fighting-game command to test, in numpad directions (2 down, 6 right, 3 down-right ...) followed by a button letter. Perform it on the gamepad or keyboard to see it match.

EditorInputMap.PauseGraphTip.source: Freeze the graphs so you can read a past spike.

EditorInputMap.PauseReplayTip.source: Stop playback at the current frame, keeping the input state of that frame.

EditorInputMap.PlayReplayTip.source: Feed the recorded frames to the engine in place of real devices, starting from the current frame.

EditorInputMap.RebindThisTip.source: Give this action's binding a different key to resolve the conflict.

EditorInputMap.RebindTip.source: Replace this binding's key: press a key or pick one from the list that opens.

EditorInputMap.ReloadTip.source: Read the input map from the path on the left, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorInputMap.ReplayFileTip.source: Resource path of the .swreplay file that Save and Load use.

EditorInputMap.ReplayHint.source: Playback attaches the replay as exclusive virtual input: recorded frame n is applied on the n-th input frame.

EditorInputMap.ResetActionTip.source: Put this action's bindings back to the ones it was loaded with.

EditorInputMap.ResetStickTip.source: Return the injected stick to the center.

EditorInputMap.RevertAllTip.source: Put every action back to the bindings it was loaded with.

EditorInputMap.RightMotorTip.source: Strength of the right (high-frequency) motor for the test pulse, 0 to 1.

EditorInputMap.SaveReplayTip.source: Write the recorded frames to the replay file.

EditorInputMap.SaveTip.source: Write the default bindings to the input map file. Player remaps are stored separately in user settings.

EditorInputMap.SelectActionHint.source: Select an action to edit its bindings and triggers.

EditorInputMap.SimStickXTip.source: Horizontal tilt to inject on gamepad 0's left stick, -1 (left) to 1 (right).

EditorInputMap.SimStickYTip.source: Vertical tilt to inject on gamepad 0's left stick, -1 (down) to 1 (up).

EditorInputMap.StartRecordingTip.source: Record every input event, frame by frame, to replay later for bug reproduction or QA. Replaces the current recording.

EditorInputMap.StopRecordingTip.source: Stop recording. The frames stay in memory until you save or record again.

EditorInputMap.StopReplayTip.source: Stop playback and rewind to the first frame.

EditorInputMap.TapKeyTip.source: Send a press and a release in the same frame, like a quick tap.

EditorInputMap.TestPulseTip.source: Vibrate gamepad 0 for 0.3 seconds with the motor strengths on the left.

EditorInputMap.TimelineFrameTip.source: Drag to jump to any recorded frame; the input state is rebuilt up to that frame.

EditorInputMap.TriggerTip.source: When the action fires (Pressed, Hold, Tap, Double Tap ...) - Unreal Enhanced Input triggers

EditorInputMap.UnbindOtherTip.source: Clear the key from the other action's binding so this action keeps it.

EditorInspector.ApplyToPrefab.source: Save this object's changes to the source prefab file

EditorInspector.FollowingSelection.source: Following the selection - click to lock to this object

EditorInspector.LockedToObject.source: Locked to this object - click to follow the selection

EditorInspector.NoTypeInfo.source: No TypeInfo registered for this component.

EditorInspector.NothingSelected.source: Nothing selected. Pick in the Scene view or use Hierarchy.

EditorInspector.ObjectActive.source: Toggle whether the GameObject is active

EditorInspector.ObjectName.source: Unique name of the GameObject (Enter to apply)

EditorInspector.RevertToPrefab.source: Revert this object to the contents of the source prefab file

EditorInspector.SearchTooltip.source: Filter by property and component name

EditorInspector.TransientProperty.source: Transient property: not saved to disk

EditorInspector.UnlinkPrefab.source: Break the link to the prefab and turn this into a standalone object

EditorInspector.Unparent.source: Detach from the parent object and move to the scene root

EditorInspector.ViewOptions.source: View options: show only modified properties, expand or collapse all sections

EditorMapCheck.CheckMap.source: Validate every object of the active scene again

EditorMapCheck.NoIssues.source: No validation issues. Check Map validates every object of the active scene.

EditorMapCheck.NotInActiveScene.source: This object is not in the active scene

EditorMapCheck.SceneIssuesToast.source: {errorCount} error(s), {warningCount} warning(s). Open Map Check from the status bar.

EditorMaterial.ApplyToSelectionTip.source: Show the edited material on the selected object in the viewport without saving, to judge it with the real shader and lighting.

EditorMaterial.LoadFailedStatus.source: Load failed - saving is disabled so the file is not overwritten

EditorMaterial.NameTip.source: Display name stored in the material file.

EditorMaterial.OpenMaterialHint.source: Open a material (Open..., Quick Open or a Content Browser double-click) to edit.

EditorMaterial.PreviewTip.source: Preview computed from the material values (base color, roughness, metallic, emissive). It does not run the shader code - use Apply to Selection to check it in the scene.

EditorMaterial.ReloadTip.source: Read the material from disk again, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorMaterial.SaveTip.source: Write the material file and reload it in the running scene.

EditorMaterial.ShaderTip.source: HLSL shader this material renders with. Drop a .hlsl file here or pick one from the Content Browser.

EditorMultiplayer.ArrangeWindows.source: Place the client windows side by side (window size and position per App process) instead of letting them overlap

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsApplyToAll.source: Send each change to every process of the session instead of the selected one

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsDisconnect.source: Drop every connection of the selected process (a client stays disconnected until Reconnect)

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsNoSession.source: Start a multiplayer session (Session tab) to change its line conditions.

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsNoStats.source: No stats yet - press Refresh stats

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsPreset.source: Set both directions of the selected process to a line preset

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsReconnect.source: Connect a disconnected client to the server again

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsRefreshStats.source: Ask the selected process for its line and connection numbers

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsSpike.source: Drop everything the selected process sends and receives for this many seconds

EditorMultiplayer.ConditionsUp.source: Packets this process sends (client to server for a client)

EditorMultiplayer.DeletePreset.source: Delete the selected preset from your preset file

EditorMultiplayer.FollowLog.source: Keep scrolling to the newest log line

EditorMultiplayer.InspectorAttach.source: Attach to a server that is already running: its debug channel address (127.0.0.1:port) and token, as given with -gv_debugChannelPort and -gv_debugChannelToken

EditorMultiplayer.InspectorConsoleHint.source: Dev command for the server (help lists them, Tab completes the name)

EditorMultiplayer.InspectorNoChannel.source: The Inspector reads a dedicated server through its debug channel. Start a Dedicated Server session, or attach by address

EditorMultiplayer.InspectorRefresh.source: Read the server's hierarchy again (scene.tree). Click a name to read its component values (object.dump) - this works while the server is paused

EditorMultiplayer.LogSource.source: Show the log of one process or of every process

EditorMultiplayer.NoProcesses.source: No processes - pick a Net Mode and press Play (toolbar or here).

EditorMultiplayer.NoTarget.source: No multiplayer session is running. Start one in the Session tab.

EditorMultiplayer.PauseServer.source: Pause the dedicated server's game tick

EditorMultiplayer.Play.source: Start the server and clients for the selected Net Mode

EditorMultiplayer.Preset.source: Saved multiplayer setups (Saved/Editor/NetPlayPresets.json, not committed). Picking one replaces the setup below and is restored when the editor starts

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerKindsAllProces.source: Add up the message kinds every process received instead of only the selected one

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerNoSession.source: Start a multiplayer session (Net Mode on the toolbar) to see its traffic

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerReceivedBytes.source: Received bytes per second (last second, all connections)

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerSentBytes.source: Sent bytes per second (last second, all connections)

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerSource.source: Numbers the process already counts (connection stats, message kinds), asked with net.stats every 0.5 s while this tab is shown

EditorMultiplayer.ProfilerWaiting.source: Waiting for the first net.stats report from this process

EditorMultiplayer.RecordTraces.source: Record a timeline per process and merge them into one file (merged.trace.json) on Stop - open it with Load Trace in the Profiler window or with Perfetto

EditorMultiplayer.ResumeServer.source: Resume the paused server's game tick

EditorMultiplayer.SavePreset.source: Save the setup below under the typed name (empty: overwrite the selected preset)

EditorMultiplayer.StepServer.source: Run the server game tick as many times as the field on the left says, then pause again (dedicated server Dev command step N)

EditorMultiplayer.StepTickCount.source: Number of server ticks that Step runs (1 or more)

EditorMultiplayer.Stop.source: Stop every process and merge the recorded traces

EditorMultiplayer.SyncCompare.source: Find the earliest tick both histories hold with different state hashes (scene transforms: name, active, world position)

EditorMultiplayer.SyncFile.source: Load a saved history, or save this one in the same format (<tick> <hex hash> per line)

EditorMultiplayer.SyncReadServer.source: Read the history of another server through its debug channel (it must run with -gv_stateHashHistory)

EditorMultiplayer.SyncSessionServer.source: Read the per-tick state hash history of the dedicated server this session started

EditorMultiplayer.Target.source: Process the tabs act on: the server or one client

EditorMultiplayer.WindowColumns.source: Windows per row before the next row starts

EditorMultiplayer.WindowSize.source: Client area size of each App window (pixels)

EditorPackaging.OpenFolder.source: Open the output folder of the last successful package in the file explorer

EditorPackaging.OutputFolder.source: Folder the packaged build is staged into

EditorPackaging.Package.source: Configure, build, cook and stage the selected game into the output folder

EditorPackaging.RHIBackend.source: Backend that Shipping links statically (client only). The server does not render

EditorPackaging.SkipBuild.source: Skip configure and build, and stage this editor's Bin

EditorPackaging.SkipCook.source: Skip cooking the resource packs (a build cooks them itself)

EditorPackaging.Target.source: Package the client (game) or the dedicated server

EditorProfiler.CallTreeRecord.source: The call tree folds the timeline recording (same recording as the Timeline tab)

EditorProfiler.Fit.source: Reset the zoom so the recorded frames fit the view

EditorProfiler.Freeze.source: Keep recording but stop updating the view

EditorProfiler.LoadTrace.source: Load the newest Saved/Traces/*.trace.json under the live threads (first times aligned) - a failing run next to a healthy one

EditorProfiler.NoComponents.source: No components in the active scene.

EditorProfiler.PauseOnSpike.source: Pause capturing automatically on a frame slower than the threshold on the right

EditorProfiler.RenderDocCapture.source: Capture the next frame with RenderDoc

EditorProfiler.RenderDocNotAttached.source: RenderDoc is not attached to this process - start with -renderdoc or launch from RenderDoc

EditorProfiler.RenderDocOpenUI.source: Open the RenderDoc replay UI to inspect captures

EditorProfiler.ResumeCapture.source: Capturing is paused (a spike or an opened capture) - resume live capture

EditorProfiler.SaveCapture.source: Save the captured window to Saved/Profiler/ProfilerCapture.txt (long captures: Tracy)

EditorProfiler.SaveTrace.source: Save the frames shown as Saved/Traces/trace_<time>.trace.json (Chrome Trace Event - open in Perfetto UI or chrome://tracing)

EditorProfiler.SpikeThreshold.source: GT.Frame above this pauses capturing (and a running play session) on that frame

EditorProfiler.TimelineRecord.source: Record profile scopes per thread into a ring (8192 events per thread) - only while recording

EditorProfiler.UnloadTrace.source: Remove the loaded trace from the timeline

EditorRenderTarget.AutoRangeTip.source: Stretch the depth values present in the image to the full black-to-white range.

EditorRenderTarget.AutoRefreshTip.source: Refresh the snapshot every 30 editor frames. Costs a GPU wait each time.

EditorRenderTarget.ChannelTip.source: Show all channels, or one channel as grayscale. RGBA shows the live GPU texture; a single channel uses the CPU snapshot.

EditorRenderTarget.FormatNotReadable.source: This format cannot be read back.

EditorRenderTarget.LinearizeTip.source: Convert stored depth back to view distance using Near/Far. Perspective depth crowds near 1, so the raw image looks almost white.

EditorRenderTarget.NearFarTip.source: Near and far clip planes of the camera that rendered the depth, in world units. Match them to that camera for correct distances.

EditorRenderTarget.NoTargets.source: Renderer has not published any targets yet.

EditorRenderTarget.PickTargetHint.source: Pick a render target on the left.

EditorRenderTarget.RefreshTip.source: Read the selected target back to the CPU again. Channel views, depth views and pixel values use this snapshot; reading waits for the GPU.

EditorRenderTarget.RegisterFailed.source: Could not register this target as an ImGui texture.

EditorRenderTarget.ZoomTip.source: Preview scale, 0 to 2. At 0 the image fits the panel; set 1 to inspect pixels at native resolution.

EditorRigDebug.BoneMarkersTip.source: Draw the bones written by the selected node in the viewport

EditorRigDebug.RigNotReady.source: The rig is not bound yet (check the rig asset and skeleton)

EditorRigDebug.SelectRig.source: Select an object with a Pose Modifier component

EditorScene.ApplyAllOverrides.source: Write every override of this instance back to the prefab template

EditorScene.CreateGameObject.source: Create a new GameObject at the root of the current scene

EditorScene.DebugDrawCategories.source: Turn DebugDrawQueue categories on or off

EditorScene.EditNestedPrefab.source: Open this nested prefab in isolation mode

EditorScene.ExitIsolation.source: Leave isolation mode without saving the prefab

EditorScene.GameViewAspect.source: Game view aspect ratio - Free (whole panel) or 16:9 (letterboxed on the spare side)

EditorScene.GameViewScreenshot.source: Save the game view image to Saved/Screenshots/<time>.png (F9 - the focused view)

EditorScene.HiddenInEditor.source: Hidden in the editor - click to show

EditorScene.HierarchySearch.source: Search by object name, or filter by component type (t:Mesh) or tag (tag:Player)

EditorScene.HistoryClear.source: Clear the whole undo history. This cannot be undone

EditorScene.HistoryRedo.source: Redo the edit that was undone. Ctrl+Y

EditorScene.LockedInViewport.source: Locked - the viewport does not pick it; click to unlock

EditorScene.MaximizeOnPlay.source: Maximize On Play - keep only the game view while playing and restore the layout on Stop

EditorScene.OpenPrefabIsolation.source: Edit the selected prefab on its own in isolation mode

EditorScene.PickableInViewport.source: Pickable in the viewport - click to lock

EditorScene.PlayModeRunning.source: Play mode is running (scene edits are restricted)

EditorScene.RefreshOverrides.source: Scan the instance for overrides again

EditorScene.RevertAllOverrides.source: Discard every override of this instance and match the prefab template

EditorScene.RevertOverride.source: Revert this property to the prefab value

EditorScene.SavePrefabExitIsolation.source: Save the prefab and leave isolation mode

EditorScene.SceneViewScreenshot.source: Save the scene view image (editor camera) to Saved/Screenshots/<time>.png - the grid and gizmos are ImGui overlays and are not included

EditorScene.ShowModifiedOnly.source: Show only the properties that differ from the prefab

EditorScene.VisibleInEditor.source: Visible in the editor - click to hide (not saved)

EditorSequencer.AddKeyTip.source: Key the target's current values on every channel at this frame.

EditorSequencer.AddPropertyTrackTip.source: Add a track that keys one numeric property of a component on the selected object.

EditorSequencer.AddRigSlotTrackTip.source: Add a track that keys a rig slot weight (PoseModifierComponent)

EditorSequencer.AddTransformTrackTip.source: Add a track that keys the selected object's position, rotation and scale.

EditorSequencer.CinematicNoteTip.source: Free-form notes saved with the sequence. It does not affect playback.

EditorSequencer.DeleteKeyTip.source: Remove this track's keys at the current frame on every channel.

EditorSequencer.DeleteTrackTip.source: Remove the selected key track and all of its keys.

EditorSequencer.ItemTargetTip.source: Name of the scene object this clip, event or camera cut acts on.

EditorSequencer.LoadTip.source: Reload the focused .seq file from disk, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorSequencer.NoKeyTracksHint.source: No key tracks. Select an object and add a transform or property track.

EditorSequencer.OpenCurveTip.source: Open this channel in the curve editor to shape the interpolation between keys.

EditorSequencer.PauseTip.source: Pause playback at the current frame.

EditorSequencer.PlayTip.source: Play the sequence in the viewport from the current frame, looping at the end.

EditorSequencer.PropertyPathTip.source: <ComponentType>.<Property> - a float32 or int32 property (for example CameraComponent._fov)

EditorSequencer.PropertyTargetNotFound.source: Target or numeric property not found

EditorSequencer.RigSlotTip.source: Rig slot name (weight_slot in the rig asset); value is clamped to 0..1

EditorSequencer.SaveTip.source: Write the sequence to the focused .seq file.

EditorSequencer.ScrubTip.source: Drag to move the current frame; the viewport follows so you can check any moment of the sequence.

EditorSequencer.SelectItemHint.source: Select a clip, event or camera cut on the timeline to edit it.

EditorSequencer.StopTip.source: Stop playback, return to the first frame and give the camera back from any camera cut.

EditorSettings.BuildModules.source: Compile every module with the changed module set

EditorSettings.GroupByModule.source: Group the variables by the module that defines them

EditorSettings.ModuleLocked.source: Editor and game modules cannot be turned off here

EditorSettings.ModuleResetOverrideTip.source: Remove this module's line from the project manifest (previews the change first)

EditorSettings.ModuleSetChanged.source: Module set changed - build to apply, then restart the editor.

EditorSettings.ModuleStateFilter.source: Filter modules by whether they are on

EditorSettings.ModuleToggle.source: Turn this module on or off (the affected modules are shown before it applies)

EditorSettings.Presets.source: Save or load named sets of global variable values

EditorSettings.PressKeyCombo.source: Press a key combo (Esc cancels, Backspace clears)

EditorSettings.RefreshModules.source: Read the module catalog from the module folder again

EditorSettings.ReplaceShortcut.source: Give this combo to the selected command and remove it from the other command

EditorSettings.ResetAllShortcuts.source: Restore every shortcut to its default binding

EditorSettings.ResetAllVariables.source: Reset every global variable to its default value

EditorSettings.ResetSection.source: Reset every value in this section to its default

EditorSettings.ResetVariable.source: Reset this variable to its default value

EditorSettings.SaveSession.source: Save the current values to the session file

EditorSettings.SetShortcut.source: Record a new shortcut for this command

EditorSettings.ShortcutInUse.source: This combo is already used. Replace clears it from the other command.

EditorSpriteClip.AnimationFirstFrameTip.source: Index of the frame this animation starts on, counting from 0.

EditorSpriteClip.AnimationFrameCountTip.source: How many consecutive frames, from the first frame, this animation plays.

EditorSpriteClip.AnimationLoopTip.source: Repeat from the first frame after the last one; off stops on the last frame.

EditorSpriteClip.AnimationNameTip.source: Name game code uses to play this animation.

EditorSpriteClip.AtlasCellTip.source: Click a cell to set the selected frame's rectangle to it. Shift+click adds a new frame.

EditorSpriteClip.AtlasTip.source: Path of the texture the frames are cut from. The UV rectangles below are fractions of this image.

EditorSpriteClip.FrameDurationTip.source: How long this frame stays on screen, in milliseconds.

EditorSpriteClip.FrameHTip.source: Frame height as a fraction of the atlas height (0-1).

EditorSpriteClip.FrameUTip.source: Left edge of the frame in the atlas, as a fraction of its width (0-1).

EditorSpriteClip.FrameVTip.source: Top edge of the frame in the atlas, as a fraction of its height (0-1).

EditorSpriteClip.FrameWTip.source: Frame width as a fraction of the atlas width (0-1).

EditorSpriteClip.KeyAngleTip.source: Rotation of the sprite at this key, in degrees.

EditorSpriteClip.KeyTimeTip.source: When this key applies, in seconds from the start of the clip.

EditorSpriteClip.LoadTip.source: Reload the clip from disk, discarding unsaved edits.

EditorSpriteClip.SaveTip.source: Write the frames, animations and keys to the clip file.

EditorSpriteClip.SliceColumnsTip.source: Number of grid columns the atlas is cut into, 1 to 64.

EditorSpriteClip.SliceRowsTip.source: Number of grid rows the atlas is cut into, 1 to 64.

EditorTileMap.ApplyEdgeTip.source: Turn every cell on this edge into a walkable warp to the target map.

EditorTileMap.ApplySizeTip.source: Resize the map to the width and height above. This clears every layer.

EditorTileMap.AtlasIdTip.source: Atlas cell index to paint, 0 to 255.

EditorTileMap.BrushTip.source: Paint every cell you press and drag over (B)

EditorTileMap.EdgeTargetTip.source: Map that walking off this edge (north, east, south or west) leads to.

EditorTileMap.EdgeTargetXTip.source: Cell column the player arrives at in the target map.

EditorTileMap.EdgeTargetYTip.source: Cell row the player arrives at in the target map.

EditorTileMap.EraseTip.source: Make the paint tools clear cells instead of painting them.

EditorTileMap.FillTip.source: Paint every connected cell that has the same value as the pressed cell (G)

EditorTileMap.HeightTip.source: Map height in cells. Takes effect when you press Apply Size.

EditorTileMap.LayerTip.source: Layer the canvas shows and the tools paint: Visual (height and tint), Warp (exits to other maps), Tile (tile set brushes) or one of the gameplay flag layers.

EditorTileMap.LoadTip.source: Read the map at Path, discarding unsaved edits. Nothing changes if no file is there.

EditorTileMap.NameTip.source: Display name stored in the map file.

EditorTileMap.PathTip.source: Resource path of the tile map file that Load and Save use.

EditorTileMap.PickerTip.source: Take the pressed cell's value as the value to paint (I)

EditorTileMap.RectTip.source: Paint the rectangle you drag out when you release the mouse (U)

EditorTileMap.ResetViewTip.source: Reset zoom and pan to the start (wheel: zoom, middle or right drag: pan)

EditorTileMap.TileSetReadFailed.source: Tile set could not be read: {path}

EditorTileMap.TileSetTip.source: Resource path of the tile set whose brushes this map paints with. Press Use to apply it.

EditorTileMap.TintTip.source: Color to paint into the cells' tint.

EditorTileMap.UseTileSetTip.source: Make this map use the tile set on the left and load its brushes.

EditorTileMap.WarpTargetTip.source: Map a painted warp cell sends the player to. Painted warp cells also become walkable.

EditorTileMap.WarpTargetXTip.source: Cell column the player arrives at in the target map.

EditorTileMap.WarpTargetYTip.source: Cell row the player arrives at in the target map.

EditorTileMap.WidthTip.source: Map width in cells. Takes effect when you press Apply Size.

EditorTip.CameraFar.source: Farthest distance the camera draws. Geometry beyond this is clipped.

EditorTip.CameraFov.source: Vertical field of view in degrees. Larger values show more of the scene and stretch the edges.

EditorTip.CameraNear.source: Closest distance the camera draws. Geometry nearer than this is clipped; keep it as large as the scene allows to avoid depth fighting.

EditorTip.CameraOrthoHeight.source: World-space height of the visible area; the width follows the aspect ratio.

EditorTip.CameraOrthographic.source: Use a parallel (non-perspective) projection, as for 2D or isometric views. FOV is ignored while on.

EditorTip.CurveKeyInterpolation.source: How the curve moves from this key to the next: Constant holds the value, Linear is a straight line, Cubic is a smooth spline.

EditorTip.CurveKeyTime.source: When the key sits on the curve's time axis. It stays between its neighbouring keys.

EditorTip.CurveKeyValue.source: The curve's value at this key.

EditorTip.DebugHUDCorner.source: Which screen corner the Debug HUD is anchored to.

EditorTip.DebugHUDOpacity.source: Background opacity of the Debug HUD panels.

EditorTip.DebugHUDOpenWindow.source: The same checklist as a runtime UI window (shows in the game view while playing)

EditorTip.DebugHUDSection.source: Show or hide this section of the in-game Debug HUD. The grey text is the section's registration name.

EditorUIPreview.BuildFailed.source: Could not build the document (see the log).

EditorUIPreview.DocumentPathTip.source: Resource path of the UI document (*.ui.xml) to preview. The preview rebuilds when it changes.

EditorUIPreview.LayoutRectsTip.source: Outline every visible widget's layout rectangle over the preview.

EditorUIPreview.ReloadTip.source: Rebuild the preview from the file, for example after editing the XML outside the editor.

EditorUIPreview.ResolutionTip.source: Screen size to lay the document out for. Check layouts at several aspect ratios before shipping.

EditorUIPreview.SafeZoneTip.source: Fraction of the screen trimmed from each edge, 0 to 0.1, as on TVs that cut off the border. The red frame shows the safe area.

EditorUIPreview.SelectWidgetHint.source: {width} x {height} UI units, scale {scale} - click the image or the tree to select a widget

EditorUIPreview.SlotAnchorPresetTip.source: Sets the anchors and recomputes the offsets so the widget stays where it is.

EditorUIPreview.SlotSizeRuleTip.source: Auto takes the desired size on the main axis; Fill shares the rest by fill weight.

EditorUIPreview.TextScaleTip.source: Player text size setting to simulate, 0.75 to 2. Use it to find labels that overflow.

EditorUIPreview.ThemeTip.source: UI theme to preview with. (game theme) uses the theme the game selects.

EditorUIPreview.UIScaleTip.source: Player UI scale setting to simulate, 0.5 to 2.

EditorUIPreview.WaitingForTexture.source: Waiting for the render thread to create the preview texture...
